bio.text: Cliff Johnson is the Democratic candidate for Mississippi's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He is a civil rights attorney and the director of the MacArthur Justice Center at the University of Mississippi School of Law.
He previously served as an assistant U.S. attorney in Mississippi during the Clinton administration and practiced law at private Mississippi firms including Butler Snow and Pigott & Johnson.
He graduated from Mississippi College and Columbia University's law school and lives in Lafayette County.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for Mississippi's 1st Congressional District in the Nov. 3 Elections
